# Frame Studio

> Frame Studio is a design and development studio (also known as Frame Web Studio) based in Rajkot, Gujarat, India. We build brand identities, websites and digital products for startups and growing businesses worldwide. Tagline: "Design, Develop, Deliver."

Frame Studio specialises in web design, web development, UI/UX design, brand identity and SEO (including GEO/AEO for AI search). Brand colours: Bright Sky Blue #00A8FF, Vivid Blue #1F69F2, Pale Aqua #E1F1EF. Brand typeface: Neue Haas Grotesk Display Pro.

## Key facts
- Name: Frame Studio
- Location: 307, Sardar Arcade, Rolex Road, Kothariya, Rajkot, Gujarat 360002, India (serving clients across India and worldwide)
- Founded: 2025
- Contact: Framestudiomail@gmail.com | +91-9510680017
- Website: https://framestudio.in

## Services
- [Web Design](https://framestudio.in/services/web-design): Custom UI/UX and website design.
- [Web Development](https://framestudio.in/services/web-development): Fast, secure, SEO-ready websites and web apps.
- [Brand Identity](https://framestudio.in/services/branding): Logo, visual identity and brand guidelines.
- [SEO & Digital Growth](https://framestudio.in/services/seo): Technical SEO, GEO and AI-search optimisation.
